name: NRE 5335
title: Advanced Stream Ecology
description: A broad overview of stream ecology will be presented. Topics covered will include stream habitats and the diversity of organisms which inhabit them, adaptations to life in running water, and energy flow and nutrient cycling in stream ecosystems. Efforts targeted at the conservation of streams will be integrated throughout the semester. One or more field trips required. Instructor consent required. Taught with NRE 4205.
requirement_description: Instructor consent. Not open for credit to students who have passed NRE 4205.
